我们班谁最努力？ (Wǒmen bān shéi zuì nǔlì?) - Who works the hardest in our class?
我们班王美努力极了。 (Wǒmen bān Wáng Měi nǔlì jí le.) - Wang Mei in our class works extremely hard.
为什么？ (Wèi shénme?) - Why?
她每天下了课就去图书馆学习。 (Tā měitiān xiàle kè jiù qù túshūguǎn xuéxí.) - Every day after class she goes to the library to study.
春节是我们国家的重要节日。 (Chūn Jié shì wǒmen guójiā de zhòngyào jiérì.) - The Spring Festival is an important festival in our country.
春节一般在每年的1月或2月。 (Chūn Jié yìbān zài měi nián de yī yuè huò èr yuè.) - The Spring Festival is usually in January or February each year.

过春节的时候，人们都要回家，除了一起吃饭以外，一家人还一起看电视台的春节晚会。 (Guò Chūn Jié de shíhou, rénmen dōu yào huí jiā, chúle yìqǐ chī fàn yǐwài, yì jiā rén hái yìqǐ kàn diànshìtái de Chūn Jié wǎnhuì.) - When celebrating the Spring Festival, people all go home; besides eating together, the family also watches the Spring Festival Gala on TV together.
一是一，二是二 (Yī shì yī, èr shì èr) - Call a spade a spade

“一是一，二是二”，这句话的意思是保留事物的真实面貌，不做任何改变，常常用来比喻一个人说话做事很诚实，不骗别人。 (“Yī shì yī, èr shì èr”, zhè jù huà de yìsi shì bǎoliú shìwù de zhēnshí miànmào, bú zuò rènhé gǎibiàn, chángcháng yònglái bǐyù yí ge rén shuō huà zuò shì hěn chéngshí, bú piàn biérén.) - The saying “一是一，二是二” means to keep the true look of something without any alteration; it is often used metaphorically to describe someone who is honest in word and deed and doesn't lie.

西方人过生日都要吃生日蛋糕，中国人的习俗是吃面条。 (Xīfāngrén guò shēngrì dōu yào chī shēngrì dàngāo, Zhōngguórén de xísú shì chī miàntiáo.) - Westerners all eat birthday cake on their birthdays, while the custom of Chinese people is to eat noodles.
面条长长的，表示“长寿”的意思。 (Miàntiáo chángcháng de, biǎoshì “chángshòu” de yìsi.) - The noodles are long, which stands for “longevity”.
因此，生日面也叫长寿面。 (Yīncǐ, shēngrì miàn yě jiào chángshòu miàn.) - Therefore, birthday noodles are also called longevity noodles.
在你们国家，人们过生日时吃什么呢？ (Zài nǐmen guójiā, rénmen guò shēngrì shí chī shénme ne?) - In your country, what do people eat on their birthdays?
我现在累得下了班就想睡觉 (Wǒ xiànzài lèi de xiàle bān jiù xiǎng shuì jiào) - I am so tired that I want to do nothing but sleep after work

我不喜欢一直住在同一个城市，想去其他城市看一看。 (Wǒ bù xǐhuan yìzhí zhù zài tóng yí ge chéngshì, xiǎng qù qítā chéngshì kàn yi kàn.) - I don't like living in the same city all the time; I want to go to other cities and have a look.

我年轻的时候也这么想，但是那时候没有钱，如果有钱，就去了。 (Wǒ niánqīng de shíhou yě zhème xiǎng, dànshì nà shíhou méiyǒu qián, rúguǒ yǒu qián, jiù qù le.) - I thought so too when I was young, but I had no money then; if I had had money, I would have gone.
那您现在为什么不去？ (Nà nín xiànzài wèi shénme bú qù?) - Then why don't you go now?
现在钱不是问题了，主要是没有时间。 (Xiànzài qián bú shì wèntí le, zhǔyào shì méiyǒu shíjiān.) - Money is no longer a problem now; the main thing is that I have no time.
我认为现在您有时间也不会出去玩儿。 (Wǒ rènwéi xiànzài nín yǒu shíjiān yě bú huì chūqu wánr.) - I think that even if you had time now, you wouldn't go out to have fun.
你说得对，我现在累得下了班就想睡觉。 (Nǐ shuō de duì, wǒ xiànzài lèi de xiàle bān jiù xiǎng shuì jiào.) - You're right; I'm now so tired that after work I just want to sleep.
谢谢你们来看我女儿。 (Xièxiè nǐmen lái kàn wǒ nǚ'ér.) - Thank you for coming to see my daughter.
你送的小皮鞋和小帽子真漂亮！ (Nǐ sòng de xiǎo píxié hé xiǎo màozi zhēn piàoliang!) - The little leather shoes and little hat you gave are really beautiful!
别客气，你女儿长得白白的、胖胖的，真可爱！ (Bié kèqi, nǐ nǚ'ér zhǎng de báibái de, pàngpàng de, zhēn kě'ài!) - You're welcome; your daughter is nice and fair and chubby, really adorable!
现在多高了？ (Xiànzài duō gāo le?) - How tall is she now?
快1米了，25公斤。 (Kuài yì mǐ le, èrshíwǔ gōngjīn.) - Almost one metre, and 25 kilograms.
你看她鼻子小小的，头发黑黑的；长得像谁？ (Nǐ kàn tā bízi xiǎoxiǎo de, tóufa hēihēi de; zhǎng de xiàng shéi?) - Look, her nose is small and her hair is black; who does she look like?

像她爸爸，刚出生时她爸爸高兴得一个晚上都没睡着。 (Xiàng tā bàba, gāng chūshēng shí tā bàba gāoxìng de yí ge wǎnshang dōu méi shuì zháo.) - Like her father; when she was just born her father was so happy that he didn't sleep a wink all night.
我的牙还是很疼。 (Wǒ de yá háishi hěn téng.) - My tooth still hurts a lot.
如果不舒服，就去医院检查一下吧。 (Rúguǒ bù shūfu, jiù qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá yíxià ba.) - If you don't feel well, go to the hospital for a check-up.
检查好几次了，但是没什么用。 (Jiǎnchá hǎo jǐ cì le, dànshì méi shénme yòng.) - I've had check-ups several times, but it's no use.
大夫怎么说的？ (Dàifu zěnme shuō de?) - What did the doctor say?
每次医生都告诉我，回家好好儿刷牙。 (Měi cì yīshēng dōu gàosu wǒ, huí jiā hǎohāor shuā yá.) - Every time the doctor tells me to go home and brush my teeth properly.

很多人都觉得现在人和人的关系冷冷的，这可能是因为工作太忙，忙得没时间跟别人见面，累得不愿意和别人多说话。 (Hěn duō rén dōu juéde xiànzài rén hé rén de guānxì lěnglěng de, zhè kěnéng shì yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng, máng de méi shíjiān gēn biérén jiàn miàn, lèi de bú yuànyì hé biérén duō shuō huà.) - Many people feel that relationships between people are cold nowadays; this may be because work is too busy—so busy that there's no time to meet others, and so tired that people are unwilling to talk much with others.

其实，我们应该多对别人笑笑，说话时如果能多用一些“您好”“谢谢”这样的词语，和别人的关系就会变得更好。 (Qíshí, wǒmen yīnggāi duō duì biérén xiàoxiao, shuō huà shí rúguǒ néng duō yòng yìxiē “nín hǎo” “xièxie” zhèyàng de cíyǔ, hé biérén de guānxì jiù huì biàn de gèng hǎo.) - In fact, we should smile at others more, and if we can use more words like “hello” and “thank you” when we speak, our relationships with others will become even better.
如果你太累了，就休息一会儿。 (Rúguǒ nǐ tài lèi le, jiù xiūxi yíhuìr.) - If you are too tired, have a rest for a while.

如果你喜欢，我就给你买。 (Rúguǒ nǐ xǐhuan, wǒ jiù gěi nǐ mǎi.) - If you like it, I'll buy it for you.
如果有钱的话，我就去旅游。 (Rúguǒ yǒu qián de huà, wǒ jiù qù lǚyóu.) - If I have money, I'll go travelling.
如果不舒服，就去医院检查一下吧。 (Rúguǒ bù shūfu, jiù qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá yíxià ba.) - If you don't feel well, go to the hospital for a check-up.
孩子们玩儿得不想回家。 (Háizimen wánr de bù xiǎng huí jiā.) - The children are playing so happily that they don't want to go home.
弟弟高兴得跳了起来。 (Dìdi gāoxìng de tiàole qǐlai.) - My younger brother was so happy that he jumped up.
儿子累得下了班就睡觉了。 (Érzi lèi de xiàle bān jiù shuì jiào le.) - The son was so tired that he went to sleep as soon as he finished work.
人们忙得没时间跟别人见面。 (Rénmen máng de méi shíjiān gēn biérén jiàn miàn.) - People are so busy that they have no time to meet others.
你送的花红红的，我很喜欢。 (Nǐ sòng de huā hónghóng de, wǒ hěn xǐhuan.) - The flowers you gave are bright red; I like them very much.

这些草绿绿的，真漂亮。 (Zhèxiē cǎo lǜlǜ de, zhēn piàoliang.) - This grass is so green; it's really beautiful.
他鼻子小小的，长得像谁？ (Tā bízi xiǎoxiǎo de, zhǎng de xiàng shéi?) - His nose is small; who does he look like?
你女儿长得白白的、胖胖的，真可爱！ (Nǐ nǚ'ér zhǎng de báibái de, pàngpàng de, zhēn kě'ài!) - Your daughter is nice and fair and chubby, really adorable!
我想去其他城市看一看。 (Wǒ xiǎng qù qítā chéngshì kàn yi kàn.) - I want to go to other cities and have a look.
你送的小皮鞋和小帽子真漂亮！ (Nǐ sòng de xiǎo píxié hé xiǎo màozi zhēn piàoliang!) - The little leather shoes and little hat you gave are really beautiful!
她长得像谁？ (Tā zhǎng de xiàng shéi?) - Who does she look like?
你去医院检查一下吧。 (Nǐ qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá yíxià ba.) - Go to the hospital for a check-up.
他和学生的关系很好。 (Tā hé xuésheng de guānxi hěn hǎo.) - He has a very good relationship with his students.
人和人的关系冷冷的。 (Rén hé rén de guānxì lěnglěng de.) - Relationships between people are cold.

如果我的丈夫能少一些会议，他就会多跟我和孩子在一起了。 (Rúguǒ wǒ de zhàngfu néng shǎo yìxiē huìyì, tā jiù huì duō gēn wǒ hé háizi zài yìqǐ le.) - If my husband could have fewer meetings, he would spend more time with me and the children.
你觉得哪个城市最好玩儿？ (Nǐ juéde nǎge chéngshì zuì hǎowánr?) - Which city do you think is the most fun?
我和同屋的关系不太好，怎么办？ (Wǒ hé tóngwū de guānxi bú tài hǎo, zěnme bàn?) - My relationship with my roommate is not very good; what should I do?
我女朋友鼻子高高的、头发长长的，非常好看。 (Wǒ nǚpéngyou bízi gāogāo de, tóufa chángcháng de, fēicháng hǎokàn.) - My girlfriend has a high nose and long hair; she is very good-looking.
那个小狗真可爱，我们把它带回家吧。 (Nàge xiǎo gǒu zhēn kě'ài, wǒmen bǎ tā dài huí jiā ba.) - That puppy is really adorable; let's take it home.
今天下午你去哪儿了？ (Jīntiān xiàwǔ nǐ qù nǎr le?) - Where did you go this afternoon?

我的车总是有问题，我去检查了一下。 (Wǒ de chē zǒngshì yǒu wèntí, wǒ qù jiǎnchále yíxià.) - My car always has problems, so I went to have it checked.
你想买点儿什么？ (Nǐ xiǎng mǎi diǎnr shénme?) - What would you like to buy?
给我来一公斤苹果。 (Gěi wǒ lái yì gōngjīn píngguǒ.) - Give me a kilogramme of apples.
你有多高？ (Nǐ yǒu duō gāo?) - How tall are you?
1米75。 (Yī mǐ qīshíwǔ.) - 1.75 metres.
你怎么刚吃饭？ (Nǐ zěnme gāng chī fàn?) - Why are you only just eating?
今天起晚了，刷牙以后就来上课了。 (Jīntiān qǐ wǎn le, shuā yá yǐhòu jiù lái shàng kè le.) - I got up late today and came to class right after brushing my teeth.
咱们去南方玩儿玩儿吧。 (Zánmen qù nánfāng wánr wánr ba.) - Let's go to the south for some fun.
我认为，还是北方更好玩儿一些。 (Wǒ rènwéi, háishi běifāng gèng hǎowánr yìxiē.) - I think the north is more fun.
生日的时候，我送给你吧。 (Shēngrì de shíhou, wǒ sòng gěi nǐ ba.) - I'll give it to you for your birthday.
真的吗？太好了。 (Zhēn de ma? Tài hǎo le.) - Really? That's great.
你怎么还不学习？ (Nǐ zěnme hái bù xuéxí?) - Why aren't you studying yet?
太好了，我现在就学习。 (Tài hǎo le, wǒ xiànzài jiù xuéxí.) - That's great, I'll study right now.
行，我自己去做饭。 (Xíng, wǒ zìjǐ qù zuò fàn.) - OK, I'll go and cook by myself.
我现在已经有女朋友了。 (Wǒ xiànzài yǐjīng yǒu nǚpéngyou le.) - I already have a girlfriend now.
HSK Level 3 Page 157 Exercises and Activities
我还没有女朋友呢，那我去吧。 (Wǒ hái méiyǒu nǚpéngyou ne, nà wǒ qù ba.) - I don't have a girlfriend yet, so I'll go.
周明年轻的时候为什么没去旅行？ (Zhōu Míng niánqīng de shíhou wèi shénme méi qù lǚxíng?) - Why didn't Zhou Ming go travelling when he was young?
现在周明为什么不能去旅行？ (Xiànzài Zhōu Míng wèi shénme bù néng qù lǚxíng?) - Why can't Zhou Ming go travelling now?
同事的女儿长得怎么样？ (Tóngshì de nǚ'ér zhǎng de zěnmeyàng?) - What does the colleague's daughter look like?
小刚为什么牙疼？ (Xiǎogāng wèi shénme yá téng?) - Why does Xiaogang have a toothache?
为什么现在人和人之间的关系冷冷的？ (Wèi shénme xiànzài rén hé rén zhījiān de guānxì lěnglěng de?) - Why are relationships between people cold nowadays?
我们怎么做才能让关系变得更好？ (Wǒmen zěnme zuò cái néng ràng guānxì biàn de gèng hǎo?) - What can we do to make relationships better?
如果有很多钱，你会做什么？ (Rúguǒ yǒu hěn duō qián, nǐ huì zuò shénme?) - If you had a lot of money, what would you do?
如果有钱，我就买一辆车。 (Rúguǒ yǒu qián, wǒ jiù mǎi yí liàng chē.) - If I had money, I would buy a car.
如果有时间，你做什么？ (Rúguǒ yǒu shíjiān, nǐ zuò shénme?) - If you had time, what would you do?
如果能去一个地方旅行，你去哪儿？ (Rúguǒ néng qù yí ge dìfang lǚxíng, nǐ qù nǎr?) - If you could travel to one place, where would you go?
如果你是超人，你会做什么？ (Rúguǒ nǐ shì chāorén, nǐ huì zuò shénme?) - If you were Superman, what would you do?
如果你是爸爸/妈妈，你不让孩子做什么？ (Rúguǒ nǐ shì bàba/māma, nǐ bú ràng háizi zuò shénme?) - If you were a father/mother, what would you not let your child do?
如果你没钱了，你怎么办？ (Rúguǒ nǐ méi qián le, nǐ zěnme bàn?) - If you ran out of money, what would you do?
他个子高高的，眼睛大大的…… (Tā gèzi gāogāo de, yǎnjing dàdà de……) - He is tall and has big eyes...

钱不是万能的 (Qián bú shì wànnéng de) - Money is not omnipotent

“钱不是万能的”，这句话的意思是钱虽然很重要，但是钱不能解决所有的问题。 (“Qián bú shì wànnéng de”, zhè jù huà de yìsi shì qián suīrán hěn zhòngyào, dànshì qián bù néng jiějué suǒyǒu de wèntí.) - “钱不是万能的” means that although money is very important, it cannot solve all problems.

这句话告诉我们对待金钱要有正确的认识，虽然生活中处处需要钱，但是有钱也不一定能办成所有的事情。 (Zhè jù huà gàosu wǒmen duìdài jīnqián yào yǒu zhèngquè de rènshi, suīrán shēnghuó zhōng chùchù xūyào qián, dànshì yǒu qián yě bù yídìng néng bàn chéng suǒyǒu de shìqing.) - This saying tells us to have a correct attitude towards money: although we need money everywhere in life, having money does not necessarily mean everything can be accomplished.
谁都有办法看好你的“病” (Shéi dōu yǒu bànfǎ kànhǎo nǐ de “bìng”) - Everybody is able to cure your “disease”

周经理，下个星期我可以请几天假吗？ (Zhōu jīnglǐ, xià ge xīngqī wǒ kěyǐ qǐng jǐ tiān jià ma?) - Manager Zhou, may I take a few days' leave next week?
你有什么事？ (Nǐ yǒu shénme shì?) - What is it about?
我的一个老朋友结婚，我跟他两年没见了。 (Wǒ de yí ge lǎo péngyou jiéhūn, wǒ gēn tā liǎng nián méi jiàn le.) - An old friend of mine is getting married, and I haven't seen him for two years.
你一共想请几天假？ (Nǐ yígòng xiǎng qǐng jǐ tiān jià?) - How many days' leave do you want in total?
三天。 (Sān tiān.) - Three days.
小丽，那个高高的男人是你们公司的吗？ (Xiǎo Lì, nàge gāogāo de nánrén shì nǐmen gōngsī de ma?) - Xiaoli, is that tall man from your company?
你对他了解吗？ (Nǐ duì tā liǎojiě ma?) - Do you know him well?

我们过去是邻居，后来是大学同学，关系一直很不错。 (Wǒmen guòqù shì línjū, hòulái shì dàxué tóngxué, guānxi yìzhí hěn búcuò.) - We used to be neighbours, and later university classmates; our relationship has always been quite good.
他一般喜欢做什么？ (Tā yìbān xǐhuan zuò shénme?) - What does he usually like to do?
他有很多爱好，唱歌、画画儿、踢足球，什么都会。 (Tā yǒu hěn duō àihào, chàng gē, huà huàr, tī zúqiú, shénme dōu huì.) - He has many hobbies: singing, drawing, playing football—he can do anything.
真的？ (Zhēn de?) - Really?
那你介绍我们认识认识吧。 (Nà nǐ jièshào wǒmen rènshi rènshi ba.) - Then introduce us to each other.
不行，现在他是我丈夫。 (Bù xíng, xiànzài tā shì wǒ zhàngfu.) - No way, he is my husband now.
最近我觉得哪儿都不舒服，你带我去医院检查检查吧。 (Zuìjìn wǒ juéde nǎr dōu bù shūfu, nǐ dài wǒ qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá jiǎnchá ba.) - Recently I feel unwell everywhere; take me to the hospital for a check-up.
不用去医院，谁都有办法看好你的“病”。 (Búyòng qù yīyuàn, shéi dōu yǒu bànfǎ kànhǎo nǐ de “bìng”.) - No need to go to the hospital; anybody has a way to cure your “disease”.
我问你，你多久没运动了？ (Wǒ wèn nǐ, nǐ duōjiǔ méi yùndòng le?) - Let me ask you, how long has it been since you exercised?
我三年没运动了。 (Wǒ sān nián méi yùndòng le.) - I haven't exercised for three years.
谁都知道运动对身体好。 (Shéi dōu zhīdào yùndòng duì shēntǐ hǎo.) - Everybody knows exercise is good for the body.
但是你吃饱了就睡。 (Dànshì nǐ chībǎole jiù shuì.) - But you go to sleep as soon as you've eaten your fill.
为了健康，我真应该多锻炼锻炼了。 (Wèile jiànkāng, wǒ zhēn yīnggāi duō duànliàn duànliàn le.) - For the sake of my health, I really should exercise more.
从明天起，我决定每天去长跑。 (Cóng míngtiān qǐ, wǒ juédìng měitiān qù chángpǎo.) - From tomorrow on, I've decided to go running every day.
“运动很重要”这句话谁都懂。 (“Yùndòng hěn zhòngyào” zhè jù huà shéi dōu dǒng.) - Everybody understands the saying “exercise is important”.
但是你知道怎么运动吗？ (Dànshì nǐ zhīdào zěnme yùndòng ma?) - But do you know how to exercise?
第一，要选择“对”的时间。 (Dì yī, yào xuǎnzé “duì” de shíjiān.) - First, you should choose the “right” time.

一般来说，早上9点是最好的时间，冬天要再晚一些。 (Yìbān lái shuō, zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn shì zuì hǎo de shíjiān, dōngtiān yào zài wǎn yìxiē.) - Generally speaking, 9 a.m. is the best time, and in winter it should be a little later.

第二，要选择“对”的地点，公园、山上、游泳馆，这些地方都可以运动。 (Dì èr, yào xuǎnzé “duì” de dìdiǎn, gōngyuán, shānshang, yóuyǒngguǎn, zhèxiē dìfang dōu kěyǐ yùndòng.) - Second, you should choose the “right” place; parks, mountains and swimming pools are all places where you can exercise.
第三，必须要根据自己的健康情况运动。 (Dì sān, bìxū yào gēnjù zìjǐ de jiànkāng qíngkuàng yùndòng.) - Third, you must exercise according to your own health condition.

如果你很久没爬山或者游泳了，运动一会儿就一定要休息休息。 (Rúguǒ nǐ hěn jiǔ méi pá shān huòzhě yóu yǒng le, yùndòng yíhuìr jiù yídìng yào xiūxi xiūxi.) - If you haven't climbed mountains or swum for a long time, you must rest after exercising for a short while.
还要记得刚运动完口渴的时候，不要马上喝水。 (Hái yào jìde gāng yùndòng wán kǒu kě de shíhou, búyào mǎshàng hē shuǐ.) - Also remember not to drink water right away when you are thirsty just after exercising.
他是谁？ (Tā shì shéi?) - Who is he?

你介绍我们认识认识吧。 (Nǐ jièshào wǒmen rènshi rènshi ba.) - Please introduce us to each other.
他是新来的，有时间你帮助帮助他吧。 (Tā shì xīn lái de, yǒu shíjiān nǐ bāngzhù bāngzhù tā ba.) - He is new here; help him when you have time.
这是本新书，你学习学习吧。 (Zhè shì běn xīn shū, nǐ xuéxí xuéxí ba.) - This is a new book; give it a try.
我真应该多锻炼锻炼了。 (Wǒ zhēn yīnggāi duō duànliàn duànliàn le.) - I really should exercise more.
谁都喜欢小丽。 (Shéi dōu xǐhuan Xiǎolì.) - Everybody likes Xiaoli.
小刚什么都喜欢吃。 (Xiǎogāng shénme dōu xǐhuan chī.) - Xiaogang likes eating everything.
我们怎么去公园都可以。 (Wǒmen zěnme qù gōngyuán dōu kěyǐ.) - It's fine for us to go to the park any way.
最近我觉得哪儿都不舒服。 (Zuìjìn wǒ juéde nǎr dōu bù shūfu.) - Recently I feel unwell everywhere.
你喜欢吃什么菜？ (Nǐ xǐhuan chī shénme cài?) - What dishes do you like to eat?
我们什么时候去看电影？ (Wǒmen shénme shíhou qù kàn diànyǐng?) - When shall we go to see a film?
我们星期天去哪儿玩儿？ (Wǒmen xīngqītiān qù nǎr wánr?) - Where shall we go to have fun on Sunday?
下个星期我可以请几天假吗？ (Xià ge xīngqī wǒ kěyǐ qǐng jǐ tiān jià ma?) - May I take a few days' leave next week?
HSK Level 3 Page 163 Exercises and Activities
他有很多爱好。 (Tā yǒu hěn duō àihào.) - He has many hobbies.
我的爱好是游泳。 (Wǒ de àihào shì yóu yǒng.) - My hobby is swimming.
谁都有办法看好你的“病”。 (Shéi dōu yǒu bànfǎ kànhǎo nǐ de “bìng”.) - Anybody has a way to cure your “disease”.
应该选择“对”的时间锻炼。 (Yīnggāi xuǎnzé “duì” de shíjiān duànliàn.) - You should choose the “right” time to exercise.
刚运动完口渴的时候，不要马上喝水。 (Gāng yùndòng wán kǒu kě de shíhou, búyào mǎshàng hē shuǐ.) - Don't drink water right away when you are thirsty just after exercising.
老师，我不舒服，我想跟您请假。 (Lǎoshī, wǒ bù shūfu, wǒ xiǎng gēn nín qǐng jià.) - Teacher, I don't feel well; I'd like to ask you for leave.
为了了解中国文化，我常常去旅行。 (Wèile liǎojiě Zhōngguó wénhuà, wǒ chángcháng qù lǚxíng.) - In order to understand Chinese culture, I often travel.
我以前在美国学习，后来来中国留学。 (Wǒ yǐqián zài Měiguó xuéxí, hòulái lái Zhōngguó liúxué.) - I used to study in the USA, and later came to study in China.
我最喜欢的季节是冬天。 (Wǒ zuì xǐhuan de jìjié shì dōngtiān.) - My favourite season is winter.
我的爱好跟你的不一样，我更喜欢游泳。 (Wǒ de àihào gēn nǐ de bù yíyàng, wǒ gèng xǐhuan yóu yǒng.) - My hobby is different from yours; I prefer swimming.
你认识那个人吗？ (Nǐ rènshi nàge rén ma?) - Do you know that person?
认识，他是我的新邻居。 (Rènshi, tā shì wǒ de xīn línjū.) - Yes, he is my new neighbour.
这次HSK你考得怎么样？ (Zhè cì HSK nǐ kǎo de zěnmeyàng?) - How did you do in the HSK this time?
好极了，一共考了280分。 (Hǎo jí le, yígòng kǎole èrbǎi bāshí fēn.) - Extremely well; I scored 280 in total.
我的口语不太好，你帮我想想办法吧。 (Wǒ de kǒuyǔ bú tài hǎo, nǐ bāng wǒ xiǎngxiang bànfǎ ba.) - My spoken Chinese is not very good; please help me think of a way.
你最好多跟中国人聊聊天儿。 (Nǐ zuìhǎo duō gēn Zhōngguórén liáoliao tiānr.) - You'd better chat with Chinese people more.
吃饱了吗？ (Chī bǎo le ma?) - Have you had enough to eat?
当然了，你看我们点了这么多菜。 (Dāngrán le, nǐ kàn wǒmen diǎnle zhème duō cài.) - Of course; look how many dishes we ordered.
明年你打算回国吗？ (Míngnián nǐ dǎsuàn huí guó ma?) - Do you plan to return to your country next year?
我还没决定呢。 (Wǒ hái méi juédìng ne.) - I haven't decided yet.
当然可以。 (Dāngrán kěyǐ.) - Of course.
HSK Level 3 Page 164 Exercises and Activities
从什么时候开始？ (Cóng shénme shíhou kāishǐ?) - Starting from when?
那从这个星期开始吧。 (Nà cóng zhège xīngqī kāishǐ ba.) - Then let's start from this week.
老师，我应该复习什么啊？ (Lǎoshī, wǒ yīnggāi fùxí shénme a?) - Teacher, what should I review?
好吧，那我都复习吧。 (Hǎo ba, nà wǒ dōu fùxí ba.) - All right, then I'll review everything.
好，我去换衣服。 (Hǎo, wǒ qù huàn yīfu.) - OK, I'll go and change my clothes.
我们去哪个公园呢？ (Wǒmen qù nǎge gōngyuán ne?) - Which park shall we go to?
周末你打算做什么？ (Zhōumò nǐ dǎsuàn zuò shénme?) - What do you plan to do at the weekend?
你每个周末都打扫房间吗？ (Nǐ měi ge zhōumò dōu dǎsǎo fángjiān ma?) - Do you clean your room every weekend?
不一定。 (Bù yídìng.) - Not necessarily.
小丽为什么要请假？ (Xiǎo Lì wèi shénme yào qǐng jià?) - Why does Xiaoli want to ask for leave?
请几天假？ (Qǐng jǐ tiān jià?) - For how many days?
小丽的丈夫有什么爱好？ (Xiǎo Lì de zhàngfu yǒu shénme àihào?) - What hobbies does Xiaoli's husband have?
周太太为什么不舒服？ (Zhōu tàitai wèi shénme bù shūfu?) - Why does Mrs Zhou feel unwell?
周太太有什么打算？ (Zhōu tàitai yǒu shénme dǎsuàn?) - What does Mrs Zhou plan to do?
什么时间运动最好？ (Shénme shíjiān yùndòng zuì hǎo?) - What time is best for exercising?
运动的时候要注意什么问题？ (Yùndòng de shíhou yào zhùyì shénme wèntí?) - What should you pay attention to when exercising?
我刚到这里，谁都不认识。 (Wǒ gāng dào zhèlǐ, shéi dōu bú rènshi.) - I've just arrived here and don't know anybody.
HSK Level 3 Page 165 Exercises and Activities
我的朋友都在这里，我谁都认识。 (Wǒ de péngyou dōu zài zhèlǐ, wǒ shéi dōu rènshi.) - My friends are all here; I know everybody.
客人要来了，我要打扫打扫房间。 (Kèrén yào lái le, wǒ yào dǎsǎo dǎsǎo fángjiān.) - Guests are coming; I'm going to tidy up the room.

早睡早起身体好 (Zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ shēntǐ hǎo) - Keeping early hours is good for your health

“早睡早起身体好”，这句话的意思是晚上早点儿睡觉，早上早点儿起床，这样对身体很有好处。 (“Zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ shēntǐ hǎo”, zhè jù huà de yìsi shì wǎnshang zǎodiǎnr shuì jiào, zǎoshang zǎodiǎnr qǐ chuáng, zhèyàng duì shēntǐ hěn yǒu hǎochù.) - “早睡早起身体好” means going to bed early at night and getting up early in the morning, which is very beneficial to your health.
这句话告诉我们养成良好的作息习惯有利于身体健康。 (Zhè jù huà gàosu wǒmen yǎngchéng liánghǎo de zuòxī xíguàn yǒulì yú shēntǐ jiànkāng.) - This saying tells us that forming a proper work-rest routine is good for our health.
我相信他们会同意的 (Wǒ xiāngxìn tāmen huì tóngyì de) - I believe they'll agree
